provenance.note: Authored unit vectors, not EmbeddingGemma embeddings. The 1.5 GB reader was not downloaded. Choice and Noul were scored by the published venn-1 head.

queues.label: Payments
queues.description: Posted charges, refunds, holds, and transfers.

queues.label: Digital assets
queues.description: Wallets and stablecoin transfers. Opened by write-back.

ACC-1001.title: Cannot sign in after travel
ACC-1001.body: The card app rejects the password. A reset email never arrives.

ACC-1002.title: One-time code rejected
ACC-1002.body: Three codes from the card app fail. The customer is locked out.

ACC-1003.title: Password reset loop
ACC-1003.body: Each new password is refused at the next sign-in.

ACC-1004.title: New phone, no access
ACC-1004.body: The trusted-device list still names the old handset.

ACC-1005.title: Biometric prompt missing
ACC-1005.body: The app asks for a password the customer no longer has.

ACC-1006.title: Joint account locked
ACC-1006.body: One holder can sign in. The other is locked after a trip.

ACC-1007.title: App update broke sign-in
ACC-1007.body: The latest card app build will not accept the password.

ACC-1008.title: Email on file is old
ACC-1008.body: Reset mail goes to an address the customer cannot open.

ACC-1009.title: Branch reset did not stick
ACC-1009.body: A teller cleared the lock. The app locked again overnight.

ACC-1010.title: VPN and the card app
ACC-1010.body: Sign-in works off the hotel Wi-Fi and fails on it.

ACC-1011.title: Security questions failed
ACC-1011.body: The answers match the file. The app still refuses.

ACC-1012.title: Passkey missing
ACC-1012.body: The device has no passkey and will not fall back.

ACC-1013.title: Travel notice, then a lock
ACC-1013.body: A travel notice was filed. Sign-in died the next morning.

ACC-1014.title: Codes arrive late
ACC-1014.body: The one-time code lands after it has already expired.

PAY-1001.title: Refund has not posted
PAY-1001.body: A merchant refund was promised four days ago and is not on the card.

PAY-1002.title: Direct debit taken twice
PAY-1002.body: The same biller drafted the account on Monday and on Tuesday.

PAY-1003.title: Payment sent to the wrong biller
PAY-1003.body: The customer paid the electric bill to the gas account.

PAY-1004.title: Statement line looks high
PAY-1004.body: A grocery charge posted for more than the receipt.

PAY-1005.title: Pending hold still there
PAY-1005.body: A hotel hold from last week has not dropped.

PAY-1006.title: Transfer between own accounts
PAY-1006.body: A move from checking to the card payment is stuck.

PAY-1007.title: Foreign ATM fee
PAY-1007.body: A cash withdrawal abroad shows a fee the customer wants explained.

PAY-1008.title: Autopay took the full balance
PAY-1008.body: The customer expected the minimum. The full balance left.

PAY-1009.title: Merchant refund to a closed card
PAY-1009.body: The refund was issued to a card that was replaced last month.

PAY-1010.title: Payment posted late
PAY-1010.body: A payment made on Friday posted on Wednesday.

PAY-1011.title: Bill pay payee rejected
PAY-1011.body: The biller will not accept the account number on file.

PAY-1012.title: Cashback not applied
PAY-1012.body: A posted purchase did not earn the stated cashback.

PAY-1013.title: Wire to a card payment
PAY-1013.body: An inbound wire was meant to pay the card and has not landed.

PAY-1014.title: Installment plan charge
PAY-1014.body: A plan installment posted on top of the full purchase.

CAR-1001.title: Replacement has not arrived
CAR-1001.body: A stolen card was blocked. The new plastic is not in the mail.

CAR-1002.title: Card lost on a trip
CAR-1002.body: The customer is abroad and needs a freeze before a replacement.

CAR-1003.title: PIN forgotten
CAR-1003.body: The plastic works at the till and fails at the ATM.

CAR-1004.title: Card swallowed by an ATM
CAR-1004.body: The machine kept the card. The account is otherwise fine.

CAR-1005.title: Name printed wrong
CAR-1005.body: The new card arrived with a misspelled surname.

CAR-1006.title: Contactless dead
CAR-1006.body: The chip works. Tap does not.

CAR-1007.title: Damaged chip
CAR-1007.body: Readers fail on the first try and then succeed.

CAR-1008.title: Additional card for a child
CAR-1008.body: A parent wants a second plastic with a low limit.

CAR-1009.title: Card never activated
CAR-1009.body: The sticker is still on. Activation in the app fails.

CAR-1010.title: Freeze after a suspicious tap
CAR-1010.body: The customer froze the card and now wants it opened.

CAR-1011.title: Expiry next month
CAR-1011.body: The replacement should already have been sent.

CAR-1012.title: Card delivered to the old flat
CAR-1012.body: The courier left the plastic at a previous address.

CAR-1013.title: Metal card request
CAR-1013.body: The customer wants the paid metal design, not more credit.

CAR-1014.title: Temporary card at a branch
CAR-1014.body: They need a branch plastic while the mailed card is in transit.

DIS-1001.title: Goods never shipped
DIS-1001.body: A web order was charged. The parcel never left the merchant.

DIS-1002.title: Hotel charged a cancelled stay
DIS-1002.body: The stay was cancelled inside the window. The charge posted.

DIS-1003.title: Subscription after cancel
DIS-1003.body: The gym drafted a month the customer had already ended.

DIS-1004.title: Counterfeit item
DIS-1004.body: The watch that arrived is not what the listing showed.

DIS-1005.title: Charged in the wrong currency
DIS-1005.body: The terminal converted a local price the customer did not accept.

DIS-1006.title: No-show the customer attended
DIS-1006.body: The salon charged a no-show. The customer was there.

DIS-1007.title: Rental damage the customer disputes
DIS-1007.body: A hire firm added a scratch the customer says was already there.

DIS-1008.title: Ticket for a cancelled flight
DIS-1008.body: The airline kept the fare after it cancelled the leg.

DIS-1009.title: Duplicate merchant, different city
DIS-1009.body: A charge names the customer's merchant but a city they have not visited.

DIS-1010.title: Service not provided
DIS-1010.body: A contractor took a deposit and did not start the work.

DIS-1011.title: Returned item, charge remains
DIS-1011.body: The shop accepted the return. The charge is still posted.

DIS-1012.title: Unauthorized tap
DIS-1012.body: A contactless charge at a bar the customer did not enter.

DIS-1013.title: Trial converted without consent
DIS-1013.body: A free trial became a paid plan with no reminder.

DIS-1014.title: Partial refund short
DIS-1014.body: The merchant refunded the goods and kept the shipping they had promised.

DSP-C01.title: Two lines for one coffee
DSP-C01.body: One tap at a cafe. The statement shows two lines for the same amount.

DSP-C02.title: Duplicate line, one receipt
DSP-C02.body: The customer has a single receipt. The statement lists the purchase twice.

DSP-C03.title: Same merchant, same minute
DSP-C03.body: Two identical posts one minute apart. The customer paid once.

DSP-C04.title: Wallet pay counted twice
DSP-C04.body: A phone tap produced two statement lines and one merchant receipt.

DSP-C05.title: Pending and posted together
DSP-C05.body: The pending line never dropped, and the posted line matches it.

DSP-C06.title: Statement echo of one fare
DSP-C06.body: A transit fare appears twice. The gate recorded one entry.

INC-1880.title: USDC will not leave the wallet
INC-1880.body: After a travel flag, the stablecoin balance is visible but a transfer of USDC never broadcasts. This is not a plastic card and not a posted merchant charge.

INC-1401.title: Locked out after travel
INC-1401.body: The card app rejects the password and the one-time code. A reset email has not arrived. A travel notice was filed last night.

INC-1408.title: Codes expire before they arrive
INC-1408.body: One-time codes land after the app has already rejected them. The customer cannot reach the account.

INC-1414.title: New phone will not sign in
INC-1414.body: The old handset is gone. The card app will not trust the new one.

INC-1419.title: Password reset did not stick
INC-1419.body: A branch cleared the lock yesterday. This morning the app locked again.

INC-1510.title: Refund still missing
INC-1510.body: A merchant refund was promised four days ago and has not posted. The customer can sign in, and the card is in hand.

INC-1516.title: Hotel hold still pending
INC-1516.body: The stay ended last week. The hold is still on the available balance.

INC-1522.title: Autopay took the full balance
INC-1522.body: The customer expected the minimum payment. The full balance left the bank account.

INC-1528.title: Cashback missing on a posted charge
INC-1528.body: The purchase posted. The cashback the offer described did not.

INC-1602.title: Replacement card has not arrived
INC-1602.body: A stolen card was blocked on Monday. The replacement is still not in the mail. The customer can sign in.

INC-1609.title: ATM kept the card
INC-1609.body: The machine swallowed the plastic. Purchases on the account are otherwise normal.

INC-1615.title: PIN fails only at ATMs
INC-1615.body: The chip pays in shops. Cash machines reject the PIN.

INC-1702.title: Invoice the lobby florist
INC-1702.body: Accounts payable asks card ops to pay the branch florist for the lobby arrangement. There is no cardholder and no card transaction.

INC-1708.title: Cancelled hotel still charged
INC-1708.body: The reservation was cancelled inside the window. The hotel charged the stay anyway.

INC-1714.title: Parcel never shipped
INC-1714.body: A web order was charged ten days ago. The merchant has no tracking number.

INC-1720.title: Gym drafted a cancelled month
INC-1720.body: The membership ended in writing. A new month still posted.

INC-1604.title: Two statement lines for one coffee
INC-1604.body: The customer was charged once at a cafe, but the statement shows two lines. They want the extra line removed, not a second refund.

INC-1881.title: Wallet transfer stuck after a travel hold
INC-1881.body: A second customer cannot send USDC. The wallet shows the coins. Nothing has posted to the card account.

tour.narration: Password and one-time codes. Closed tickets and the queue descriptions name the same queue.

tour.kicker: A refund that has not posted
tour.narration: The customer can sign in and the card is in hand. Both paths name Payments.

tour.kicker: Words that point at the wrong queue
tour.narration: The wording sounds like a payment. Duplicate-line filings were resolved in Disputes, and that history is nearer than the Payments description.
An internal invoice, not a cardholder. History abstains. The fit question says it does not belong. Descriptions can still name a listed queue: that signal is not a guardrail.

tour.kicker: A kind of ticket the desk has not seen
tour.narration: No closed wallet case exists, so history will not name a queue. Resolving it and writing the case back is how a new queue enters the model.

action.label: Resolve in Digital assets and write back

tour.narration: One written-back case is now the nearest reference, so this ticket routes to Digital assets. The four descriptions still cannot name that queue.
